chunkpilot.command.diagnose.noc2me.warn: §c⚠ No C2ME: vanilla worldgen/light throughput measures only ~20-40 chunks/s per server.
chunkpilot.command.diagnose.noc2me.over: §c⚠ Current demand %.0f chunks/s far exceeds throughput → the forward frontier will collapse and players will be repeatedly rubber-banded.
chunkpilot.command.diagnose.advice: §eSuggestions (best value first): ① install C2ME (the only real throughput fix) ② lower view-distance to ≈ %1$d or below ③ cap speed at ≈ %2$s m/s or below ④ reduce concurrent flying players
chunkpilot.command.diagnose.ok_single: §a✓ Current demand is within vanilla single-threaded throughput; it should keep up.
chunkpilot.command.diagnose.c2me_ok: §a✓ C2ME is installed (parallel worldgen/lighting); measured to hold the frontier even with 5 players at 34 m/s
